title: Tom Is Sick
text:
Tom is sick today. He has a cold and a sore throat. He stays in bed and drinks warm tea. His mother gives him medicine.

The doctor comes to the house in the afternoon. She checks Tom's temperature. She says he needs to rest for two days. Tom feels better soon.

options: A cold and a sore throat

questions.text: How long does the doctor say Tom needs to rest?
Why does Tom stay in bed?
options: He is ill and needs rest

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel at the end of the story?

vocabulary.definition: a person who helps sick people
something you take when you are sick
how hot or cold a person's body is
to relax and not work or move much

paragraph_translations: Том сьогодні хворий. У нього застуда і болить горло. Він лежить у ліжку і п'є теплий чай. Мама дає йому ліки.
Лікар приходить до дому вдень. Вона перевіряє температуру Тома. Вона каже, що йому потрібно відпочивати два дні. Том незабаром почувається краще.
